Order No.04 Dated- 14.06.2024 Heard the parties.

Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Hatgamharia P.S. Case No.11 of 2021 registered under sections 420/467/468/414/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code, under Section 4/21 of the M.M.D.R. Act, 1957 and under Rule 11 of the Jharkhand Minerals (Prevention of illegal Mining, Transportation and Storage) Rules, 2017.
The Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this is the third journey of the petitioner for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail and earlier the prayers for grant of anticipatory bail were rejected twice vide order dated 12.04.2022 in A.B.A. No. 2434 of 2022 and vide order dated 24.02.2023 in A.B.A. No. 8693 of 2022.

entities.text: Jharkhand Minerals (Prevention of illegal Mining, Transportation and Storage) Rules, 2017
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is next submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that since some material submissions could not be made by the earlier counsel so the petitioner has engaged a better Counsel and some documents have been annexed with this anticipatory bail application.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Learned Addl. P.P. on the other hand vehemently opposes the prayer for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail and submits that there is specific allegation against the petitioner of being the owner of the truck which was involved in transportation of 18.200 M.T. iron ores on the basis of Md. Imraz Khan vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... .... ... on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20596819/
1 forged documents.

entities.text: Md. Imraz Khan vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the e-transit pass purportedly issued by the Department of Steel & Mines, Government of Odisha kept inside the cabin of the truck upon verification was found to be forged one and the Mining Office denied to have issued such e-transit passes and clarified the same to be forged documents.

entities.text: Department of Steel & Mines, Government of Odisha
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Hence, the custodial interrogation of the petitioner is required during the investigation of the case to find out the details of the forgery committed as well as the details of the driver of the said vehicle.

It is next submitted that the allegations against the co-accused -Krishnendu Sutradhar who has been given the privilege of anticipatory bail stands on a different footing than the petitioner and as such, there is no fresh ground to consider the prayer for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
It is also submitted that, the petitioner even after repeated rejection of his anticipatory bail applications is not cooperating with the investigation and he is absconding.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner ought not to be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Considering the serious nature of allegations against the petitioner and the requirement of his custodial interrogation during the investigation of the case to find out the details of forgery, this Court is of the considered view that this is not a fit case where the above named petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail of the above named petitioner is rejected.

(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Sonu/Gunjan- Md. Imraz Khan vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... .... ... on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20596819/
